column3: “Your consolations” is rendered “your way of consolation.”
“Not will my spirit be short” is rendered “should I not be impatient.”
“Turn to me” is rendered “Look at me”; NASB supplies “your.”
“Grow old” is rendered “Continue on,” and “become strong strength” as “become very powerful.”
“Bull” is rendered “ox,” and “impregnates and does not fail” as “mates without fail.”
“In a moment” is rendered “suddenly.” The written text reads “they wear out,” the reading aloud “they complete.”
“What is the Almighty” is rendered “Who is the Almighty.”
NASB supplies “You say” and “a man's.” “His wickedness” is rendered “a man's iniquity.”
“Destruction” is rendered “decay”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
“What is his pleasure” is rendered “what does he care.”
“With his complete limbs” is rendered “in his full strength.”
“His pails are full of milk” is rendered “His sides are filled out with fat”; the meaning of the Hebrew words is uncertain.
“You do violence” is rendered “you would wrong.”
